Our Three Branches

Scout Sections & Age Framework

Each unit is tailored to nurture character, friendship, autonomy, and outdoor woodcraft at every stage of youth.

Ages 4 – 11 قراميز و زهرات

Gramiz & Zahrat

Louveteaux & Jeannettes / Zahrat

Scout Motto: De notre mieux (Do our best)

The younger branches welcome children into a warm, safe pack. Through story-driven games, creative crafts, basic camping skills, and community values, they learn to share, take responsibility, and grow in confidence alongside their pack leaders (Akela & Baloo).

Weekly Meeting Schedule:

Saturdays, 3:00 PM – 4:30 PM

What Scouts Learn & Do

  • ✓ Jungle book lore & outdoor games
  • ✓ Knot tying and basic survival skills
  • ✓ Nature scavenger hunts and mini hikes
  • ✓ Community sharing & Christmas charity drives
  • ✓ Annual weekend spring & summer camp
Inquire on WhatsApp for Gramiz & Zahrat Join This Saturday (3:00 PM)
Ages 11 – 16 كشافة و مرشدات

Kochefe & Mourchidet

Éclaireurs & Guides

Scout Motto: Toujours Prêt (Always Prepared)

At the heart of the scout adventure, boys and girls form autonomous patrols led by a Patrol Leader (Patrouille). They design and build their own wooden camp installations (froissartage), cook their own meals on fires, hike rugged mountain trails, and discover true camaraderie.

Weekly Meeting Schedule:

Saturdays, 3:00 PM – 4:30 PM

What Scouts Learn & Do

  • ✓ Pioneering & woodcraft installations (Froissartage)
  • ✓ Orienteering with topographic maps & compass
  • ✓ Campfire cooking, bivouacs & 10-day summer camp
  • ✓ First aid certification & outdoor safety
  • ✓ Patrol tournaments and physical challenges
Inquire on WhatsApp for Kochefe & Mourchidet Join This Saturday (3:00 PM)
Ages 16 – 24 جوالة و منجدات

Jouwele & Mounjidet

Routiers & Caravelles

Scout Motto: Servir (To Serve)

The senior branch is a brotherhood and sisterhood of the Open Road. Members take on ambitious humanitarian initiatives, wilderness expeditions across Lebanon, emergency relief, and prepare to step up into leadership roles as chefs and community pillars.

Weekly Meeting Schedule:

Saturdays, 3:00 PM – 4:30 PM (and special missions)

What Scouts Learn & Do

  • ✓ Humanitarian expeditions & community development
  • ✓ Long-distance mountain treks (Lebanon Mountain Trail)
  • ✓ Leadership training & assistant section mentoring
  • ✓ Social solidarity & parish heritage preservation
  • ✓ Spiritual retreats and self-reflection fires
Inquire on WhatsApp for Jouwele & Mounjidet Join This Saturday (3:00 PM)

Not sure which section fits your child?

Visit us this Saturday between 3:00 PM and 4:30 PM at the Saint Jean Marc scout hall. Our chefs will gladly guide you.

Scout Des Cèdres كشافة الأرز
Groupe Saint Jean Marc فوج القديس يوحنا مرقس

Founded on May 5, 1977. Serving youth through fellowship, outdoor woodcraft, personal character, and civic service at Saint Jean Marc, Byblos. تأسس الفوج في ٥ أيار ١٩٧٧. تنشئة أجيال على روح الأخوة، مهارات الخلاء، بناء الشخصية، وخدمة المجتمع في رعية مار يوحنا مرقس، جبيل.
